title: PallyPower
wikitext: Pally Power provides an easy to use interface that allows you to set blessings and automatically checks for missing buffs with an easy to read indicator. == How to install == # Visit the GitHub link you find, then click the green '''<> Code''' button, and select Download ZIP. # Use [https://www.7-zip.org/ 7zip] to extract the zip into your TWow/Interface/AddOns # Rename the PallyPower-master folder to PallyPower # Restart the game == Git Links == * [https://github.com/Beardedrasta/PallyPower '''(Beardedrasta)'''] * [https://github.com/ivanovlk/PallyPowerTW '''(ivanovlk)'''] - this version needs to be renamed to PallyPowerTW * [https://github.com/madScripting/PallyPower-TurtleWoW '''(madScripting)'''] == Commands == Use /pp to open the graphical user interface. == Preview == [[File:Pp2.png|frameless|580x580px]] == Changes == * Option to change between regular blessings and greater blessings. * Shows the buff frame when solo. * Show the max rank of each blessing each paladin has available and if they have talents that buff the blessing. * Show the correct duration to each blessing. * Shaman class in the buff table. * Hunter pet Support. * Auto self-cast Support. == Contributors == * Aznamir (author) * [https://github.com/armando-lima Armando Lima] * [https://github.com/CosminPOP CosminPOP] * [https://github.com/Azgaardian Azgaardian] * [https://github.com/madScripting madScripting] * [https://github.com/Dauls Dauls] * jb6357 [[Category:Addon]]
